title: CmdFX
description: Give your server a polished feel with clean command actions and flexible custom command creation.
body:
![CmdFX Header](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e74b7fc05ba30812180e13354097fcb90c17f456.png)
## <center> Introduction </center>

CmdFX lets you add custom actions to commands on your server without making the setup complicated.

You can send a chat message, show an action bar, display a title, play a sound, or run extra commands when players use specific commands. It also supports making custom commands, so you can apply the same effects to your own command setup too.

## <center> Key Features </center>

- Add effects to commands from specific plugins
- Create your own custom commands like `/discord`, `/rules`, and more, no limits
- Optional cooldowns, permissions, and player only commands
- Supports PlaceholderAPI (soft dependency)
- Supports minecraft versions from **1.8 to latest**
- Lightweight and designed to stay out of the way
- Regular updates and improvements


Perfect for servers that want a **modern feel**, better feedback, and clean command interactions.

## <center> Commands </center>

- `/cmdfx help` - Show available commands
- `/cmdfx sounds` - Search available sounds
- `/cmdfx reload` - Reload the plugin

## <center> Support </center>
